answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 39699 Country: India Title: During the time of fasting can one do miswak Question: During the time of fasting can one do miswak? Answer ID: 39699 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 993/626/H=1433) Yes, one can do miswak in the state of fast, there is no harm. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
